inputs.name: findGuide.topic
inputs.description: The topic string supplied to findGuide is passed to findGuideByTopic with the module's assembled guides. It matters when selecting guidance by topic; this wrapper does not validate or transform the string.

outputs.name: guides
outputs.description: guides is the module's array of Guide records, assembled from imported guides, inline records, and generated guide factories before a topic-based naming-rule map is applied. Its records use the Guide fields, and imported definitions determine the full list.

examples.summary: Add data behavior through a small ActiveRecord-like model and an adapter.
steps: Generate the model with fields and the target adapter.
Keep persistence calls inside the model or adapter, not in controllers.
Add validations near the model before wiring UI or API behavior.
Write model tests before adding higher-level workflow tests.
rules: One model file owns one table-shaped concept.

Model contracts document source-declared methods and fields, never exported constants as outputs. Show initialization and persistence methods only when they exist; shared interfaces do not imply database behavior.

Document database structure from the selected model definition in a separate Table tab. Inspect committed syntax without importing model code or reading a live database; leave dynamic schemas explicitly unresolved.
Use adapters for D1, SQLite, and Postgres differences.
Keep queries named by intent instead of scattering SQL.
antiPatterns: Do not put controller response formatting in models.
Do not create a generic database utility that knows every table.
exampleCommands: harness generate model Post title:string body:text --adapter d1

outputs.name: findGuide
outputs.description: This is the value returned by findGuideByTopic(guides, topic) for a requested topic. Its declared type permits a Guide or undefined, and this wrapper does not reshape the result.

examples.summary: Add request handling as a thin coordinator.
steps: Call models and services from small action methods.
Cover the action with a focused test.
rules: Controllers parse input and shape output.
Business decisions belong in services or models.
Each action should fit on one screen.
antiPatterns: Do not put SQL in controllers.
Do not mix page rendering and API mutation logic.

outputs.name: availableGuideTopics
outputs.description: availableGuideTopics() returns the strings produced by uniqueGuideTopics(guides). It matters when callers need the assembled guide topics, and this wrapper returns the helper result unchanged.
